verified: NASASpaceflight reported that the first stage arrived at SLC-14 on Nov. 22 and entered the HIF, and that Stage 2 completed cryogenic proof testing and a full wet dress rehearsal; Stoke Space's own X post said a rocket was at SLC-14 for the first time in 60 years.
unconfirmed: The early 2027 launch date and the December Stage 2 static fire are Stoke's plans, not completed events; the report gives no payload capacity, price, or independent confirmation that the integrated vehicle will fly on that schedule.

verified: 一级已于 11 月 22 日抵达 SLC-14 并进入水平总装厂房；二级在摩西湖已完成贮箱结构验证（各贮箱加压至设计压力的 110%）和一次以液氢液氧为推进剂的全流程湿式演练；七台 Zenith 发动机中有四台完成验收测试——这些数据来自 Stoke Space 与 NASASpaceflight 的报道。
unconfirmed: 2027 年初首飞只是目标时间，尚无确定的发射日期；湿式演练与两次静态点火能否按计划通过、剩余三台 Zenith 何时完成验收并运抵佛罗里达，均未得到确认；报道中提到的 Block 2 重型构型与融资细节因原文截断而无法核实。

titles.en: Stoke Space's Nova Pathfinder booster arrives at SLC-14 ahead of 2027 debut
titles.zh: Stoke Space 新星一级抵达 SLC-14，目标 2027 年初首飞
